pyqgis_plugin.name: Add Transparency Slider
pyqgis_plugin.description: Adds an 'Add / Remove transparency slider' item to the layer tree context menu (after 'Show Labels' or 'Show in Overview') to manage opacity sliders.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Adds a convenient context menu action in the QGIS layer panel (dynamically placed after 'Show Labels' or 'Show in Overview') to conditionally add or remove the embedded transparency (opacity) slider for map layers with a single click.
